item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 01/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the subtropical ridge strengthening gradually, the weather will become fine over southeastern China this week, and it will be persistently very hot.

Date/Month: 01/07 (Monday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms. Very hot with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 02/07 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Sunny intervals and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
